Four defects found by running php-src's OWN stream test suite
(`ext/standard/tests/streams` + `.../filters`) through both implementations.

`fwrite()` TOOK ONLY TWO ARGUMENTS. php's signature is
`fwrite($stream, string $data, ?int $length = null)`, so `fwrite($h, $data, 4)`
did not compile at all. The cap is `max(0, min($length, strlen($data)))`, and a
non-positive one writes nothing WITHOUT raising — measured: `fwrite($h,"hello",0)`
